Priest.note: From the BlizzCon demo. Fear Ward is now baseline for every Priest. Rank 1 numbers come from Warcraft Tavern's spellbook screenshots; higher ranks from level 38 spellbooks on stream.
Priest.source: Warcraft Tavern's rank 1 spellbook screenshots from the BlizzCon demo floor, 12 Sep 2026 (all twelve Priest racials, pointed out by Typical_Effect_9054 on Reddit); Dark Sacrifice rank 2 from demo footage; Night Elf spells read from Savix's Twitch VOD of 12 Sep 2026; Troll rank 3 tooltips from demo spellbook screenshots shared by Schiffers on Reddit, 13 Sep 2026, matched by admiralbfalcon's captures from Xaryu's stream; Gnome Contingency Plan rank 2 from admiralbfalcon, 13 Sep 2026.

Human.name: Divine Grace
Human.description: New. Rank 1: instant, 40 yd, 10 min cooldown. Heals a friendly target below 50% health for 220 to 257 and removes Weakened Soul from them. Cannot be cast on yourself.

Human.name: Feedback
Human.description: Rank 1: 55 mana, instant, 3 min cooldown. For 15 sec, any spell that hits you burns 18 of the attacker's mana and deals 1 Shadow damage per point burned.

Dwarf.name: Chastise
Dwarf.description: Rank 1: 50 mana, instant, 20 yd, 2 min cooldown. 50 to 57 Holy damage and roots the target for up to 2 sec. Humanoids only, very low threat. Same idea as TBC.

Dwarf.name: Desperate Prayer
Dwarf.description: Rank 1: instant, 10 min cooldown. Heals you for 220 to 257.

Night Elf.name: Elune's Grace
Night Elf.description: Changed. Instant, 26 mana, 5 min cooldown: reduces the chance you will be hit by melee and ranged attacks by 50% for 15 sec or until you are missed 3 times. (Classic: ranged only, plus dodge, 3 min cooldown.) Read from the demo spellbook at level 38.

Night Elf.name: Starshards
Night Elf.description: Changed. Rank 4 at 38: 190 mana, 30 yd, channeled, 30 sec cooldown. Rains starshards on the target for 816 Arcane damage over 6 sec. Rank 1 is 50 mana for 216. (Classic: no cooldown and far less damage.)

Gnome.name: Confounding Flash
Gnome.description: New. Rank 1: 26 mana, 0.5 sec cast, 2 min cooldown. Confuses up to 5 enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Any damage breaks it.

Gnome.name: Contingency Plan
Gnome.description: New. Rank 2 at 38: 220 mana, instant, 30 yd, 10 min cooldown. Places a Holy ward on an ally for 15 sec; the next hit that drops them below 35% health gives them a 290 absorb and heals 338 over 15 sec. One per target. Rank 1 is 130 mana, 155 absorb, 300 heal.

Undead.name: Dark Sacrifice
Undead.description: Instant, 10 min cooldown. Rank 2 at 38: cannibalize 720 of your own health over 15 sec to gain 720 mana. Rank 1: 532 health for 440 mana.

Undead.name: Touch of Weakness
Undead.description: Rank 1: 12 mana, instant. The next melee attack against you deals 20 Shadow damage to the attacker and cuts their melee attack power by 43 for 2 min.

Troll.name: Hex of Weakness
Troll.description: Changed. Rank 3 at 38: 45 mana, instant, 30 yd. Reduces the target's melee attack power by 85 and the effectiveness of healing on it by 20% for 2 min. Rank 1 is 35 mana and 43 attack power. (Classic reduced flat melee damage instead of attack power.)

Troll.name: Shadowguard
Troll.description: Rank 3 at 38: 30 mana, instant. Shadows strike anyone who hits you with a spell, melee or ranged attack for 76 Shadow damage, once every few seconds, no threat. 3 charges, lasts 10 min. Rank 1 is 50 mana and 34 damage.
